title: atoll disk add --json
description: The disk added, or with --dry-run the disk that would be, after its checks (specs.md §10, §18, §25). A disk refused gives exit 1 and nothing on standard output.

state.description: What its mount check gives: a disk missing is refused.

reason.description: Why it is readonly (specs.md §10), null when online.

physical_disks.description: The whole disks the filesystem lives on, by their kernel names, in byte order; null when they could not be told.

warnings.description: In the order they arose; each is also said on standard error. readonly: the disk takes no copy until mounted read-write. topology-unchecked: whether it shares a physical disk with another is not known. not-immutable, immutable-unchecked: the folder under its mount point is not immutable, or that is not known. catalog-not-updated, marker-not-written, daemon-not-told: added to the configuration, and that step left undone, with exit 4. config-not-synced: the configuration is written, and its folder could not be synced after, with exit 4.
